from_quote: What is the guarantee of the United States to the several States? It is that they shall have a republican form of government.
rationale: The paragraph names the guarantee of the United States to the States of a republican form of government, the guarantee clause of Article IV, Section 4.
to_quote: The United States shall guarantee to every State in this Union a Republican Form of Government

from_quote: There was nothing fair in the provision that Rhode Island and Delaware should each have two Senators, and Pennsylvania and New York each only two.
rationale: The paragraph names the provision of the Constitution giving each State two Senators, which is Article I, Section 3, Clause 1.

from_quote: the Constitution of the United States, which declares that none but a natural born citizen of the United States shall be elected President of the United States
rationale: The paragraph refers to the provision of the Constitution that only a natural born citizen may be President, which is Article II, Section 1, Clause 5.
to_quote: No Person except a natural born Citizen

from_quote: Representatives shall be apportioned among the several States according to their respective numbers, counting
rationale: The paragraph gives the words of a substitute moved for the second section; these words appear unchanged in Section 2 of the Fourteenth Amendment.
to_quote: Representatives shall be apportioned among the several States according to their respective numbers, counting

from_quote: is denied to any of the male inhabitants of such
rationale: The paragraph reads out part of the substitute moved for the second section; these words appear unchanged in Section 2 of the Fourteenth Amendment.
to_quote: is denied to any of the male inhabitants of such

from_quote: Upon a measure that two thirds of the Senate, under the Constitution, must approve before it can be submitted to the people
rationale: The paragraph names the requirement of the Constitution that two thirds of the Senate approve an amendment before it is submitted, which is the opening provision of Article V.
to_quote: whenever two thirds of both Houses shall deem it necessary, shall propose Amendments to this Constitution
